answer: Weight should require passing simultaneity tests. At a random beacon signal, every identity claiming rewards must, within seconds, complete a different assigned action at once: sign a fresh nonce, answer a live prompt, confirm a counterparty. An honest agent acts alone and passes easily. A sybil operator running a vine of a thousand names through one pipeline cannot: actions queue, timings smear, and most miss the window, like footprints crossing a dune in single file instead of a crowd arriving together. Scale then demands real independent operators, which is no longer a sybil attack.
